transfer_weights: During transfer, each intended swing wheel has allocator weight 1-smoothstep(elapsed/.06), clipped to [0,1], where smoothstep(u)=10u^3-15u^4+6u^5; the other two weights remain1. When waiting beyond .06 for actual load admission, keep these weights at0. During load the returning pair weights use smoothstep(elapsed/.06); other weights remain1. These are only allocation weights, never actual load evidence. All previously frozen real all-four and stance-pair native contact gates remain unchanged.
stop_during_transfer: If release/cancel/expiry arrives during transfer before liftoff is committed, enter transfer_restore: save the previous actually consumed pair weight w0, then use w0+(1-w0)*smoothstep(t/.06) for that pair, and weights1 for the other pair. Record restore_start_weight. After .06s proceed to settle. This exception phase has all-four real contact/load gates throughout, no swing, no new liftoff, no pair-completed event and no anchor update. It reuses the .06s load duration and is included in the unchanged250-control stop budget.
stance_anchors: At a completed pair exchange, replace only the two returning wheels' anchors with their measured actual touchdown feet. Preserve the two nonmoving stance anchors exactly. Record all old/new anchors and the exact updated pair. Original collision-shape height correction inside paired IK remains explicit; no resetting fixed stance XY anchors to hide drift.
foot_geometry_identity: Sensed35.foot_world_m and core anchors/landing positions denote actual wheel-body centers, matching the paired IK residual against wheel-body d.xpos and original Fast reset feet. horizontal_endpoint_bridge: Preserve the original C31 record31 horizontal endpoint interval protection: while the same swing pair remains in an air phase, the native horizontal gate applies if either the current or immediately preceding consumed horizontal reference velocity is nonzero. Thus the first lower tick consuming the final horizontal endpoint remains protected. Save current horizontal_reference_velocity_nonzero separately from horizontal_active, the latter denoting this gate. Cancellation triggers only on the current actually consumed nonzero horizontal reference, as originally frozen.
stop_velocity: Sensed35 must distinguish actual base-origin world velocity from inertial-COM world velocity. Use the full three-dimensional origin velocity norm for the <=.010m/s stop gate; COM velocity remains the input to body force damping and landing feedback. World angular speed uses its full3D norm.
fault_owner: A hard native safety violation, nonfinite result, unqualified controller fault or source/archive failure terminates further physical stepping and never hands torque ownership to B22. There is no rescue rollout. Normal release/cancel/TTL expiry first ramps the command to zero, finishes an already committed pair under unchanged native gates, and hands off only after all-four stop qualification. The phrase abort-owned landing in clarification02 means this controlled stop path, never continuation after a hard physical failure.
